title: JAR workloads in clean rooms are now generally available
body: You can now run compiled Java or Scala code in clean rooms. Run a JAR as its own clean room analysis, or register a function from a JAR and call it from a clean room notebook as a temporary UDF. See [Run JAR workloads in Databricks clean rooms](/aws/en/clean-rooms/clean-room-jar-task).
